# DeNshe Jewellery
> Anti-tarnish, everyday gold-tone jewellery and curated gift sets based in Anand, Gujarat, India.

## Overview
DeNshe (`denshe.shop`) is an independent direct-to-consumer (D2C) jewellery label founded by two best friends, Neshma and Devanshi. DeNshe specializes in anti-tarnish everyday wear, gold-tone pieces, Indian oxidised curations, and signature gifting sets.

- **Website**: https://denshe.shop
- **Founders**: Neshma & Devanshi
- **Base / Dispatch Location**: Anand, Gujarat, India (PIN 388001)
- **Shipping**: Nationwide across India (Free shipping on orders above ₹599)
- **Support**: WhatsApp (+91 9586488320) & Email (denshe1713@gmail.com)

## Product Categories & Collections
- **Anti-Tarnish Everyday Earrings**: Hoops, studs, huggies, drops, and balis designed for sensitive ears with durable gold-tone finishes.
- **Everyday Kadas & Bracelets**: Slim daily wear cuffs, stacked bracelets, and traditional yet minimal kadas.
- **Everyday Rings**: Adjustable and band rings crafted for comfort and lasting shine.
- **Necklaces & Chain Pendants**: Layering chains and minimal pendants designed for everyday wear.
- **Potlis & Jars (Curated Gifting)**: Handcrafted keepsake jars and mystery jewellery surprise boxes from ₹499.
- **The Modern Edit**: Minimalist daily-wear jewellery designed for modern styling.
- **The Festive Edit**: Celebration-ready, Indian oxidised, and statement jewellery.

## Materials & Quality Commitment
- **Finish**: Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish that resists daily wear.
- **Attributes**: Anti-tarnish, skin-friendly, and comfortable for everyday use.
